segments.name: Products and Systems Integration
products: on-premises and cloud-based access control solutions
segments.description: Sells mission-critical communications infrastructure and devices, video security cameras and access control hardware to public safety, government, defense and enterprise customers.
segments.evidence: In 2025, the segment's net sales were $7.3 billion, representing 62% of our consolidated net sales.

segments.name: Software and Services
products: video network management and access control software
decision management and digital evidence management software
segments.description: Provides support, managed and cybersecurity services plus video, command center and cloud software for public safety, government and enterprise customers.
segments.evidence: In 2025, the segment's net sales were $4.4 billion, representing 38% of our consolidated net sales.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for devices and communications systems, including installation and integration, and for software, subscriptions, cloud and managed/support services.
revenueModel.evidence: Primary sources of revenue for this technology come from selling devices and building communications systems, including the installation and integration of our infrastructure equipment within our customers' operations.

changes.text: In 2025, following the Silvus acquisition, the company renamed its Land Mobile Radio Communications technology to Mission Critical Networks.
changes.evidence: Following the acquisition of Silvus Technologies Holdings Inc. ("Silvus") in August 2025, we renamed our "Land Mobile Radio Communications" technology to "Mission Critical Networks."
